name: readme-builder
description: A powerful, interactive README generator built with React, Vite, and Tailwind CSS. Create professional documentation in minutes.

paragraphs: README Forge (formerly Readme Builder Pro) is a comprehensive tool designed to help developers create stunning, professional README.md files for their repositories without the hassle of writing markdown from scratch. With an intuitive drag-and-drop interface, real-time preview, intelligent quality scoring, and a suite of pre-built templates, documenting your projects has never been easier.

The project recently underwent a major production-quality upgrade, introducing a newly revamped premium landing page, a new GitHub-inspired design system, advanced keyboard navigation, and an intelligent README analyzer.
